run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T07:46:30Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend coincides with a rise in frontend error spans that started at about 07:45-07:46Z: frontend's error-span rate was 0/s from 07:37:00Z through 07:45:00Z, first became nonzero at 07:46:00Z (0.085/s), peaked at 4.53/s at 07:51:00Z and was 2.76/s at 07:56:00Z. The failing frontend spans are its CartService client calls and the cart/checkout HTTP routes; the cart service produced its own error spans on its CartService server operations, and cart's pod logs repeat "Error status code ..."/"Wasn't able to connect to redis" from 07:45:33Z/07:46:35Z. The cart datastore pod otel-demo/valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft (Deployment valkey-cart, the only otel-demo deployment with 0 available replicas) is in CrashLoopBackOff, restartCount 4, last termination OOMKilled exit 137, with no ready endpoint address. Events show chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-valkey-memory-stress spawning a StressChaos every minute from 07:45:24Z that reports applying chaos to otel-demo/valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft/valkey-cart; that injection began seconds before cart's first error log and just before the frontend error-rate rise and the alert start 07:46:30Z, and the container's 10Mi memory limit leaves little headroom. The frontend<-cart<-valkey propagation is inferred from operation names, timings and cart's own redis errors; no incident-window spans exist in Jaeger (newest frontend trace 07:25:31Z) and the Schedule/StressChaos custom resources could not be read, so the conclusion is partial.

claims.text: Over the 4726s window ending 2026-11-17T08:05:16Z, error-status span increase by service_name was: frontend 782.6, frontend-proxy 639.1, cart 229.8, checkout 64.9, fraud-detection 3.05, recommendation 3.05, ad 2.04, accounting 0, payment 0 (span counts, not request counts).

frontend's error-span rate (sum of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} over 2m) was 0 from 07:37:00Z through 07:45:00Z, then 0.085/s at 07:46:00Z, 0.844/s at 07:49:00Z, peak 4.53/s at 07:51:00Z, and 2.76/s at the last returned point 07:56:00Z.
Immediately before the fault, the increase of frontend error spans over the 1200s ending 2026-11-17T07:45:00Z was 0; cart and checkout error series were not returned for that evaluation.

frontend's whole-window error spans concentrate on cart paths: client grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem 123.0, client grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 85.4, internal 'executing api route (pages) /api/cart' 208.4, server 'POST /api/cart' 151.4, server 'GET /api/cart' 56.9, server 'POST' 38.6, 'POST /api/checkout' 32.5, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 32.5, client CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 32.5, server 'GET' 21.3; /api/data error spans were 0.

The cart service produced its own error spans on server operations POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem (increase 124.75), POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart (103.94) and POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart (1.125) over the window.
cart's error-span rate (2m) first became nonzero at 07:47:00Z (0.0425/s) and was 0.92/s at 07:56:00Z; checkout's first nonzero error rate was 0.17/s at 07:50:00Z.

In pod cart-755465879b-4p8d9 the earliest matching lines in 07:40:00-07:48:00Z were "Error status code '{StatusCode}' with detail '{Detail}' raised." at 07:45:33.535Z and the first "Wasn't able to connect to redis" at 07:46:35.337Z; in the wider read the same redis-connection errors repeat continuously through the newest shown line 07:53:53.333Z (324 matching lines, newest 100 shown).

Pod otel-demo/valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft container valkey-cart: restartCount 4, ready false, state waiting/CrashLoopBackOff ("back-off 1m20s restarting failed container"), lastState terminated reason OOMKilled with exitCode 137, startedAt 2026-11-17T07:49:18Z and finishedAt 2026-11-17T07:49:29Z.

Deployment valkey-cart is the only otel-demo deployment without available replicas (desired 1, available <none>, ready <none>, unavailable 1); the other 20 deployments each report 1 desired/1 available/1 ready, including cart and frontend.
Endpoints object valkey-cart has no ready addresses; its only address is listed under notReadyAddresses (100.96.5.138, targetRef Pod valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft).

Chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-valkey-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh emitted Spawned events creating new objects every minute from 07:45:24Z through 07:53:09Z (otel-demo-valkey-memory-stress-flgz4, -ckxt6, -w8p5x, -nt6th, -95xf6, -ltcpd, -v75mv, -psc57) and Forbid events at 07:51:24, 07:52:24, 07:53:09 and 07:53:24 stating the previous object 'is still running'.

The spawned StressChaos objects report "Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft/valkey-cart" at 07:45:24, 07:46:24, 07:47:24, 07:48:24, 07:49:24 and 07:52:14Z, each followed about 55s later by TimeUp/Recovered; kubelet also recorded 22 BackOff events for that pod's valkey-cart container from 07:46:28Z to 07:53:46Z.
The valkey-cart container spec uses image valkey/valkey:8.1.3-alpine with resources limits cpu 10m / memory 10Mi and requests cpu 2m / memory 4Mi.

All 21 otel-demo pods are in phase Running; every pod other than valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft is ready with 0 restarts, including cart-755465879b-4p8d9 and frontend-675fd7b5c5-x9gbm (0 restarts, ready true).

checkout's own error spans are cart-bound: server oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 31.9, client oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 17.6, client oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 1.125, client 'HTTP POST' 14.3.
ReplicaSet ownership is intact: cart-755465879b is owned by Deployment cart with 1 ready replica, and valkey-cart-58df56c79c is owned by Deployment valkey-cart with no readyReplicas.

Jaeger's newest returned frontend trace in the authorized window ended at 2026-11-17T07:25:31Z (50 frontend spans, all http.status_code 200), so no span-level view of the 07:45-08:00Z period exists; Jaeger lists 18 services and no valkey service.

Primary causal chain: chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-valkey-memory-stress repeatedly injected memory stress into container valkey-cart of pod valkey-cart-58df56c79c-4cvft from 07:45:24Z; the valkey process was OOMKilled (exit 137) and entered CrashLoopBackOff, leaving no ready valkey-cart endpoint; the cart service then failed redis connections (its own log lines) and returned errors on AddItem/GetCart/EmptyCart; frontend's CartService client spans and checkout's cart-bound PlaceOrder failed, producing the frontend error rate the alert reports. The frontend<-cart propagation is inferred from operation names and timing, not from observed parent references, because incident-window traces are unavailable.

Contributing configuration rather than trigger: the valkey-cart container's 10Mi memory limit leaves little headroom, so memory stress reaches OOM quickly; the zero frontend error baseline through 07:45:00Z and valkey restarts appearing only after the first stress application at 07:45:24Z indicate the limit alone did not start this incident.

A cart or frontend rollout/restart caused these failures: rejected — cart-755465879b-4p8d9 and frontend-675fd7b5c5-x9gbm have 0 restarts, the cart and frontend deployments are 1/1 available, and cart's ReplicaSet cart-755465879b is owned by Deployment cart with 1 ready replica.

The Killing/FailedKillPod events on pod cart-9fd895bb7-m7zfz (last 07:44:19Z) caused this error burst: rejected as this cause — that is a different pod that no longer exists, while the current cart pod cart-755465879b-4p8d9 has 0 restarts and the error onset at 07:45:33Z/07:46:00Z follows the valkey memory-stress application at 07:45:24Z.

Obtain CRD-level access to inspect or suspend chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-valkey-memory-stress and its StressChaos experiments (memory stressor size, duration, selector) to confirm the injected pressure and stop further OOM kills of valkey-cart.

Raise the valkey-cart container memory limit above 10Mi (aligning requests) or exclude valkey-cart from memory-stress chaos, then confirm the valkey-cart pod becomes Ready and its Endpoints object gains a ready address.

gaps: The chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-valkey-memory-stress and its StressChaos objects are custom resources the allowed Kubernetes kinds cannot read; their spec (stressor size, duration, selector) could not be verified, so the injection's parameters rest on events only.

Jaeger has no traces for the incident window: the search for frontend traces in 07:45:00-08:00:00Z (status no_data) and the newest full-window frontend trace ending 07:25:31Z mean frontend->cart parent-child edges and incident span error details could not be verified.

A frontend pod log query for 'error|Error|fail|Fail|cart|redis' on frontend-675fd7b5c5-x9gbm returned no lines (status no_data), so frontend's own log text is unavailable; frontend impact rests on its error-span metrics.
A valkey-cart pod log read returned no lines and reported no previous container instance (status no_data), so the valkey process's own output around its OOM kills is unknown.

list_prometheus_rules for rule name RequestErrorRate returned nothing (status no_data), and an instant query for frontend error spans by span_name/status_code at 08:00:00Z also returned nothing, so the alerting rule expression could not be checked and its annotation value 3.022 was not independently reproduced.
Queries for networkpolicies and resourcequotas in otel-demo returned no objects; that shows only what those queries matched and does not establish absence of policy or quota problems.
Per-restart timestamps for the valkey-cart container's earlier restarts are not exposed (only lastState 07:49:18-07:49:29Z), so the sequence of OOM kills after 07:45:24Z is only partially known.

The Killing (75) and FailedKillPod (22) events on pod cart-9fd895bb7-m7zfz, last at 07:44:19Z, concern a pod that no longer exists; no evidence ties them to this incident and their origin is unexplained.
Small error-span increases on ad (2.04), fraud-detection (3.05) and recommendation (3.05) were not investigated and are not tied to the valkey fault.
next_steps: Inspect the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-valkey-memory-stress (namespace chaos-mesh) and its StressChaos history with CRD access, and suspend it if the memory stress is not intended.

After remediation, verify valkey-cart pod readiness, the valkey-cart Endpoints ready address, that cart's "Wasn't able to connect to redis" lines stop, and that frontend/cart error-span rates return to the pre-07:45 baseline.
Review the RequestErrorRate rule definition (expression, threshold, evaluation window) in the alerting configuration, since it was not retrievable from Prometheus under that name.
